title: USCIS updates policy manual to clarify family-based immigration requirements - NewsBreak
text:
(FOX40.COM) — The U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Service announced they are issuing policy guidance in the USCIS Policy Manual , which will enhance the capability to screen and vet family-based immigrant visa petitions.
• Video above: Deportation Process According to USCIS, this update will explain the requirements and adjudication process for these petitions, including eligibility criteria, filing procedures, interviews, and decisions. Fraudulent, frivolous, or otherwise non-meritorious family-based immigrant petitions weaken confidence in family-based pathways to lawful permanent resident status and undermine family unity in the United States, USCIS said. “This guidance will improve USCIS’s capacity to vet qualifying marriages and family relationships to ensure they are genuine, verifiable, and compliant with all applicable laws,” authorities said. “USCIS is prioritizing robust alien screening and vetting that protects Americans from potential national security threats. We are committed to keeping Americans safe by detecting aliens with potentially harmful intent so they can be processed for removal from the United States.” The update focuses on clarifying certain requirements for family-based immigrants by: For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to FOX40 News.
